deployments_detail.use: Full Self-Driving (FSD) neural nets + custom AI inference chips + Optimus humanoid robot + robotaxi

Factory computer-vision AI for quality control — production-grade ML models power visual inspection and defect detection across body panels, welds, and painted surfaces at production stages in Tesla factories. [Tesla in-house (Factory Vision Systems)]
Cortex AI training supercluster at Giga Texas — ~50,000 Nvidia H100 GPUs live in Q4 2024 (expanding toward ~100k H100/H200), used to train FSD and Optimus neural networks. [Nvidia (H100/H200)]

Full Self-Driving (Supervised) — end-to-end neural networks that take raw camera input and output vehicle controls (steering, acceleration, braking); v12+ replaced ~300k lines of hand-written C++ with a single trained model, deployed to the customer fleet. [Tesla in-house (FSD neural nets)]

Robotaxi driverless ride-hailing service launched to the public in Austin, Texas, running on the FSD autonomy stack; first paid autonomous rides began June 2025 with a small fleet expanding over time. [Tesla in-house (FSD / Robotaxi)]

Optimus general-purpose bipedal humanoid robot using Tesla's AI/neural-net stack for autonomous perception and manipulation; being trained and piloted for factory tasks, not yet commercially deployed. [Tesla in-house (Optimus)]

Grok in-vehicle AI voice assistant — xAI's Grok integrated into Tesla vehicles as a hands-free conversational companion answering real-time questions; rolled out to the fleet starting July 2025. [xAI (Grok)]

Autobidder — real-time AI trading and dispatch-control platform that autonomously bids and dispatches battery/energy-storage assets into wholesale power markets to maximize value; deployed managing utility-scale storage portfolios. [Tesla in-house (Autobidder / Opticaster)]
deployments_detail.value: managing over 1.2 GWh of energy storage (2021)

deployments_detail.use: Tesla Assist — AI-powered website chatbot providing instant answers to product/service questions, scheduling service, explaining leases, and booking demo/test drives; live on Tesla's site.
Tesla Service AI Agent — AI system that monitors service-communication delays, tracks customer sentiment, and auto-escalates issues to leadership; launched as a pilot at 10 service locations.

Tesla Real-Time Insurance — pricing engine that uses real-time vehicle telematics (acceleration, braking, following distance, speed, FSD usage) to compute a per-driver Safety Score and set monthly premiums. [Tesla in-house (Safety Score)]
deployments_detail.value: average drivers estimated to save 20-40% on premiums
